parameters.name: CompletedBeginTime
parameters.description: The start time when the task was completed. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: CompletedEndTime
parameters.description: The end time when the task was completed. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: EndMillis
parameters.description: The end time of the task run. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 10 entries are returned on each page.

> Specify a value for PageSize.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> For more information, see [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~).

parameters.name: QueryValue
parameters.description: The input parameter of the playbook.

parameters.name: RequestUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook task execution.

> For more information, see [DescribeSoarRecords](~~2627455~~).

parameters.name: StartMillis
parameters.description: The start time of the task run. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the task run. Valid values:

- **success**: The task is successful.

- **failed**: The task failed.

- **inprogress**: The task is in progress.

parameters.name: TaskflowMd5
parameters.description: The MD5 value of the playbook configuration.

parameters.name: TriggerType
parameters.description:
The trigger type of the task. Valid values:

- **stream**: stream

- **debug**: test

- **manual**: manual

- **timer**: scheduled

- **SubInvoke**: child flow

- **siem**: triggered by a SIEM product

parameters.name: TriggerUser
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that runs the playbook task.
